# Palmer Logistics

Palmer Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Palmer Logistics is a warehousing company with facilities in Houston, Dallas, and Savannah that offers customer-focused warehouse solutions. Palmer Logistics employs 114 people (+2.7% YoY, +3 people) and has an annual revenue of $10M, founded in 1965. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, United States, with an office in Baytown.

## About

TRUSTED LOGISTICS SOLUTIONS SINCE 1965 
Veteran-Owned • Family-Run • Purpose-Driven

We are a certified veteran-owned Third Party Logistics (3PL) provider serving manufacturers, distributors, and shippers across Texas, Georgia, and the U.S.

Founded in 1965, we offer reliable, safe, and custom logistics solutions that help businesses stay efficient and compliant.

WHAT WE DO:
• Hazardous & Non-Hazardous Chemical Warehousing 
• Food-Grade Storage & General Commodities 
• Labeling, Repackaging, Kitting & Fulfillment 
• Solids Loading, Liquid Packaging & Decanting 
• Import Receiving, Inspection, Securement & Export Shipping 
• Shuttle, Drayage & Rail-Served Transportation

Houston, La Porte, Baytown, Pasadena, Grand Prairie TX 
Pooler GA

We don’t just move freight—we move businesses forward. 
Let’s connect.

# RHP Logistics

RHP Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RHP Logistics is a WBENC Certified Company offering logistics, transportation & trucking services throughout Taylor & beyond. RHP Logistics employs 7 people, founded in 2007. Headquartered in Warren, Michigan, United States, with an office in Taylor.

## About

RHP Logistics provides world class global household relocation, truckload and LTL transportation including final mile delivery, global commercial relocation, sensitive equipment transportation and warehousing. RHP Logistics partners with industry leaders in each of our market segments.

Affordance Office Furniture is a division of Palmer Logistics Services. Affordance provides space planning, design services and furniture installation for companies large and small throughout the state of Michigan and represents and installs over 200 high quality commercial furniture manufacturers. Visit palmerls.com/office-furniture/ to learn more.

Palmer Logistics Services is proud to be a Women Owned Business and winner of the NEI Global Relocation Own It Award.
